This user-friendly platform empowers parents to stay well-informed about their child's educational journey. Through the app, they can efficiently review academic performance metrics, attendance records, and other relevant statistics. Additionally, the inclusion of polls facilitates parent engagement, enabling them to contribute feedback and opinions on various aspects of their child's schooling experience. This collaborative and accessible approach not only keeps parents informed but also actively involves them in supporting and enhancing their child's educational progress.
